items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: Rapolo says, we got that fixed, Jake.

ctx.x: Did you have a hard time getting in the union then?

Well, it wasn't easy. See, these fellas, when they came, Rapolo, when he came down here, of course I'm not a well-educated man, I'm not an educated man, and then I was a young man, you know how a young person feels about it like that. Like they say, sometimes he don't even think about danger, he thinks about it after it's too late, you know. But he came down over to the house and he asked me if he'd like me to go to Chicago, join the New Orleans Rhythm Kings. So I told him, I says, well, Rapolo says, you know I'm…
Finish this? Oh, I think so. We're not in a great hurry. Jake, before we get too far.
